_about: Motion inspiration for Loom's films. Each idea is a real, recognisable motion habit translated into the studio's knobs: reveal (rise, slide, fade, scale, type), stagger (0.5 to 2, how far apart words arrive), drift (none, push, pan: the frame moving while a shot holds), ease (sharp, smooth, soft, snap), tempo (0.6 to 1.6, higher is faster), transition (cut, mask, wipe, push) and fieldTone (field or accent). The director picks one idea per project that suits its direction; the inspiration fetcher adds more over time.

ideas.name: Keynote rise
ideas.idea: Big words rise from their baseline one at a time on a long ease-out, then hold in silence.

ideas.name: Swiss hard cut
ideas.idea: No easing between shots: each frame is a new poster on the beat, words slide in from the left edge.

ideas.name: Slow push-in
ideas.idea: Every shot creeps forward a few percent while it holds, like a camera on a dolly.

ideas.name: Typed out
ideas.idea: Words appear letter by letter like they are being typed, nothing slides.

ideas.name: Pop scale
ideas.idea: Words pop up from small with a little overshoot, playful and quick.

ideas.name: Chapter wipes
ideas.idea: A solid block of colour wipes up between ideas, like turning pages in a printed report.

ideas.name: Accent chapters
ideas.idea: Chapter breaks flood the frame with the accent colour instead of black.

ideas.name: Lateral pan
ideas.idea: The frame slides sideways a little while each shot holds, like reading a wide spread.

ideas.name: Stacked push
ideas.idea: Each shot pushes the last one up and out, like cards dealt on a table.

ideas.name: Whisper fade
ideas.idea: Soft fades, wide spacing between words, long holds. Confidence through restraint.

ideas.name: Staccato
ideas.idea: Fast, tight, every word lands on its own beat with almost no gap.

ideas.name: Kinetic headline
ideas.idea: The headline is the whole film: lines rise, sink and are replaced by the next line.

ideas.name: Instrument readout
ideas.idea: Numbers count up precisely, text types in, the frame never moves.

ideas.name: Gallery walk
ideas.idea: Pictures open like shutters and drift slowly; words stay small and arrive late.

ideas.name: Zine snap
ideas.idea: Cheeky and quick: words pop and the frames cut like a photocopied zine.
ideas.from: Indie zine and gig poster reels

ideas.name: Film credits
ideas.idea: Measured, centred pace like opening credits: fade in, hold, fade out, push gently.

ideas.name: News ticker
ideas.idea: Facts slide in from the side like a broadcast lower-third, hard cuts between stories.

ideas.name: Page turn
ideas.idea: Each shot is a page of a book pushed up into the next, quiet type, steady pace.

ideas.name: Launch countdown
ideas.idea: Energy builds: the pace quickens, numbers count, the name lands last and huge.

ideas.name: Architect's model
ideas.idea: Slow lateral drift across large, calm pictures with precise small captions.

ideas.name: Specimen flash
ideas.idea: Words replace each other in place at speed, like flicking through a type specimen.

ideas.name: Manifesto
ideas.idea: Short sentences hit one after another on colour fields, each one a statement of belief.

ideas.name: Lab notes
ideas.idea: Plain and honest: typed captions over real screens, cut cleanly, no flourish.

ideas.name: Soft bounce
ideas.idea: Friendly: words scale up with a gentle overshoot, shots push up like cards.
